required_topics: Definition of human trafficking and commercial exploitation of children
Identification of individuals most at risk for human trafficking
Differences between labor and sex trafficking, particularly as it relates to lodging establishments, restaurants, and truck stops
Role of employees in reporting and responding to instances of human trafficking
risks_or_constraints: Non-compliance with training requirements can lead to civil penalties
notes: Training must be completed within six months of beginning employment and every two years thereafter.
The legislation is part of broader efforts across the United States to combat human trafficking.
